problem: The vector $a$ has magnitude $9,$ the vector $b$ has magnitude $5,$ the angle between $a$ and $b$ is ${140}^{∘}$ and $n$ is the unit vector that points in the direction of $a\times b.$ Find $a\times b$ in terms of $n.$ Round your final answer to the nearest integer where appropriate.
worked_solution:
We use the formula for the cross product and obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}a\times b & =|a|\cdot |b|\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡\theta \cdot n \\  & =9\cdot 5\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{140}^{∘}\cdot n \\  & =45\cdot (0.642…)\cdot n \\  & =(28.925…)\cdot n \\  & ≈29n.\end{aligned}
$$
